title: Paste-format help behind the (i) icon still can't be opened by a click or tap
where: /admin/lists/[id], Add numbers dialog, 'Or paste numbers' (i) icon, 1440 and 390
what_happens: Still there from round 1. Clicking the (i) next to 'Or paste numbers' shows nothing (screenshot taken 0.5s after the click, at 1440 and at 390). The help is a hover tooltip, so on a phone a tap never shows it.
who_hurts: An admin adding numbers from a phone who wants to know the paste format (name, language, Costa Rica default) can't read it.
suggested_fix: Swap the Tooltip for the app's Popover (src/components/ui/popover.tsx) on that (i) button in add-members-form.tsx, so a click or tap opens the same text.
rule: Dane's rule: explanation goes 'behind a small "i" icon or tooltip' - it has to open on the devices admins use. General: WCAG 2.2 1.4.13.
origin: this change (round 1 finding, not yet fixed)
